description: This Java class 'JobExecutionRepository' provides database access methods related to job execution management within the Fineract project, including retrieving stuck jobs, updating job statuses, and querying job parameters.

classes.name: JobExecutionRepository
classes.description: Repository class for managing job execution data, including fetching stuck jobs, updating statuses, and retrieving job parameters based on database type.

methods.name: getStuckJobNames
methods.description: Retrieves a list of job names that are considered 'stuck' based on retry threshold and job status.

methods.name: getStuckJobCountByJobName
methods.description: Returns the count of stuck jobs for a specific job name.

methods.name: getStuckJobIdsByJobName
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of jobs that are stuck for a specific job name.

methods.name: getNotCompletedPartitionsCount
methods.description: Counts the number of partitions in a job execution that are not yet completed.

methods.name: updateJobStatusToFailed
methods.description: Updates the status of a stuck job and its step to 'FAILED'.

methods.name: getBusinessDateOfRunningJobByExecutionParameter
methods.description: Fetches the business date parameter of a running job based on specific execution parameters, handling different database types.
